question: Up to what point in life do the prescribed rites extend in this sequence?
premises: The return rite and marriage are included among the rites.
The rites are enumerated as a series.
The series extends to the end of life.
inference: The rites, including the return rite and marriage, extend up to death.
plain_english: The return rite, marriage, and the other rites extend all the way to death.
